data.long_meaning: A peaceful, calm, and serene name. Derived from the Arabic root 'qasama' which means tranquility and calmness. The name Qaseema carries the meaning “Calmness, serenity, tranquility” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qaseema usually hope their child will grow to embody calmness, serenity, tranquility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
